title: FACTS-MAS: A Multi-Agent Architecture for Adaptive Forecasting from Heterogeneous Evidence
abstract: arXiv:2610.38225v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Real-world forecasting often requires integrating heterogeneous evidence whose predictive value varies across horizons, operating regimes, and domains. We introduce FACTS-MAS, a domain-agnostic multi-agent forecasting framework that decomposes evidence into specialized channels for temporal dynamics, exogenous context, seasonality, structural information, and discrete events. Each agent generates an independently testable forecast through a common interface, while leakage-safe historical validation measures its predictive skill relative to a naive reference. These skill estimates are used to weight and combine agent forecasts, so that uninformative evidence is either removed or downweighted rather than forced to participate. A calibration procedure selects domain-specific constant means based on historical validation folds. translated_title: FACTS-MAS：一种基于异构证据进行自适应预测的多智能体架构
translated_abstract: 现实世界的预测任务通常需要整合异构证据，而这些证据的预测价值会随时间跨度、运行状态和领域的不同而变化。我们提出了 FACTS-MAS，一个与领域无关的多智能体预测框架，它将证据分解为若干专门化通道：时间动态、外生背景、季节性、结构信息以及离散事件。每个智能体通过统一接口生成可独立检验的预测，同时采用无泄漏的历史验证来衡量其相对于朴素基准的预测能力。这些能力评估结果被用于对各智能体的预测进行加权和组合，使得缺乏信息量的证据被移除或降权，而不是被迫参与预测。此外，校准程序会基于历史验证折选取特定于领域的常数均值。我们在 Zillow 的每周在售房屋库存数据和每周失业保险申领数据上对 FACTS-MAS 进行了评估……
tldr: FACTS-MAS 是一个与领域无关的多智能体预测框架，它将异构证据分解为专门化通道，通过无泄漏历史验证评估各智能体的预测能力并据此自适应加权组合，从而让无信息量的证据被移除或降权。
en_tdlr: FACTS-MAS is a domain-agnostic multi-agent forecasting framework that decomposes heterogeneous evidence into specialized channels, uses leakage-safe historical validation to assess each agent's predictive skill, and adaptively weights and combines forecasts so that uninformative evidence is removed or downweighted.
